decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans therewith (Drawing Numbers: PRC JTA EX AL 010 P1, 050 P1, 100 P1, 110 P1, 120 P1, 130 P1, 200 P1, 210 P1, 300 P1, 310 P1, 320 P1; PRC JTA DE AL 050 P1, 100 P1; PRC JTA PR AL 010 P1, 050 P1, 100 P1, 110 P1, 120 P1, 130 P1, 140 P1, 200 P1, 210 P1, 300 P1, 310 P1, 320 P1, 330 P1, Design and Access Statement received 19/05/11.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side roof extension shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Single storey rear extension, side and rear roof extensions, installation of solar panels to the roof and erection of a single storey outbuilding in the rear garden of the house.
